# axual_application_deployment_state (List Resource)

Lists the running state of application deployments, one result per deployment.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `application` (String) Only resources of this application. Takes the application's ID, short name or exact name.
- `environment` (String) Only resources on this environment. Takes the environment's ID, short name or exact name.
- `owners` (String) Only deployments of applications owned by this group. Takes the group's ID or its exact name.
